```{=html}
<section class="recap-grignan">

<style>
@import url('[https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Comfortaa:wght@700&display=swap](https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Comfortaa:wght@700&display=swap)');

/* =====================================
   FOND ET DÉCORATIONS
===================================== */

html,
body,
#quarto-content {
  background-color: #F4F0E8 !important;
}

.recap-grignan {
  --navy: #203653;
  --blue: #3979ad;
  --gold: #b58a38;
  --red: #bd514b;
  --green: #42836b;
  --purple: #784ba0;
  --ink: #303b49;
  --muted: #687585;

  font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: transparent;
  padding: 30px 10px;
  max-width: 950px;
  margin: auto;
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.recap-grignan *,
.facebook-video * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* LAVANDE À DROITE */

.lavande-filigrane {
  position: fixed;
  right: 15px;
  bottom: 10px;
  width: 190px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.17;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* ÉPI DE BLÉ À GAUCHE */

.ble-filigrane {
  position: fixed;
  left: 8px;
  bottom: 15px;
  width: 175px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.19;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* =====================================
   EN-TÊTE
===================================== */

.recap-grignan .header {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 100%;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 30px 10px 35px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.recap-grignan .header h1.essentiel-title {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  color: #111111 !important;
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', sans-serif !important;
  font-size: clamp(42px, 8.5vw, 64px);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.15;
  text-align: center !important;
  margin: 12px auto;
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
}

.recap-grignan .header h1.essentiel-title .anchorjs-link {
  display: none !important;
}

.recap-grignan .header-filigrane {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  width: 100%;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.recap-grignan .header-filigrane svg {
  width: 175px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.72;
}

.recap-grignan .eyebrow {
  color: #9b784b;
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 3px;
  font-weight: bold;
  text-align: center;
}

.recap-grignan .subtitle {
  color: #666;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.65;
  text-align: center;
}

/* =====================================
   CARTES
===================================== */

.recap-grignan .timeline {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 15px;
}

.recap-grignan .card {
  background: #f8f9fa;
  border: 1px solid #e1e6ec;
  border-radius: 11px;
  padding: 21px;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(30,50,75,.045);
  border-top: 4px solid var(--blue);
}

.recap-grignan .card.gold {
  border-top-color: var(--gold);
}

.recap-grignan .card.red {
  border-top-color: var(--red);
}

.recap-grignan .card.green {
  border-top-color: var(--green);
}

.recap-grignan .card.navy {
  border-top-color: var(--navy);
}

.recap-grignan .card.purple {
  border-top-color: var(--purple);
}

.recap-grignan .card-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 13px;
}

.recap-grignan .symbol {
  width: 45px;
  height: 45px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: #edf3fa;
  border-radius: 12px;
  font-size: 24px;
}

.recap-grignan .gold .symbol {
  background: #f8f1df;
}

.recap-grignan .red .symbol {
  background: #faeae8;
}

.recap-grignan .green .symbol {
  background: #e8f3ed;
}

.recap-grignan .purple .symbol {
  background: #f2eaf8;
}

.recap-grignan .number {
  color: var(--blue);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}

.recap-grignan .gold .number {
  color: var(--gold);
}

.recap-grignan .purple .number {
  color: var(--purple);
}

.recap-grignan .legal .number {
  color: var(--red);
}

.recap-grignan h3 {
  color: var(--navy);
  font-size: 18px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  line-height: 1.4;
  margin: 3px 0 0;
}

.recap-grignan p {
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: #596675;
  margin: 0;
}

.recap-grignan strong {
  color: var(--navy);
}

.recap-grignan .gold strong {
  color: #967024;
}

.recap-grignan .red strong,
.recap-grignan .legal strong {
  color: var(--red);
}

.recap-grignan .purple strong {
  color: var(--purple);
}

/* =====================================
   FINANCEMENT
===================================== */

.recap-grignan .money {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 5px 0 12px;
}

.recap-grignan .money strong {
  font-family: Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 38px;
  color: #a43f39;
}

.recap-grignan .money span {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--muted);
}

/* =====================================
   THÈME ENCADRÉS 5 ET 6 (LEGAL)
===================================== */

.recap-grignan .legal {
  background: #fff8f6;
  border: 1px solid #f0d4cf;
  border-top: 4px solid var(--red);
}

.recap-grignan .legal .symbol {
  background: #f9e6e2;
}

.recap-grignan .legal h3 {
  color: #a43f39;
}

/* =====================================
   RÉFÉRENCES ET BOUTONS
===================================== */

.recap-grignan .references {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 15px;
  padding-top: 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid #edf0f3;
}

.recap-grignan .legal .references {
  border-top-color: #f0d4cf;
}

.recap-grignan .reference,
.recap-grignan .legal-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 7px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  background: #f1f5f9;
  border: 1px solid #e0e7ef;
  border-radius: 7px;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  color: var(--navy);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.4;
  transition: background .2s, border-color .2s;
}

.recap-grignan .legal .reference,
.recap-grignan .legal .legal-link {
  background: #fdf1ef;
  border-color: #edd0cb;
  color: #8c3731;
}

.recap-grignan .reference:hover,
.recap-grignan .legal-link:hover {
  background: #e5edf6;
  border-color: #b7c9dc;
}

.recap-grignan .legal .reference:hover,
.recap-grignan .legal .legal-link:hover {
  background: #f9e2de;
  border-color: #e2b4ac;
}

.recap-grignan .reference-icon {
  font-size: 19px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.recap-grignan .reference small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 400;
}

.recap-grignan .legal .reference small {
  color: #875650;
}

/* BOUTON RÉPONSE UDAP */

.recap-grignan .udap-link {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: 6px;
  padding: 13px 15px;
  background: #f9e6e2;
  border: 1px solid #e7b9b1;
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: #923c35;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: bold;
  line-height: 1.5;
  transition: background .2s, transform .2s;
}

.recap-grignan .udap-link:hover {
  background: #f3d5cf;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.recap-grignan .udap-link small {
  display: block;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: normal;
  color: #875650;
}

/* =====================================
   CONCLUSION
===================================== */

.recap-grignan .conclusion {
  margin-top: 20px;
  padding: 22px;
  background: var(--navy);
  color: white;
  text-align: center;
  border-radius: 11px;
}

.recap-grignan .conclusion .icon {
  font-size: 28px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.recap-grignan .conclusion strong {
  color: white;
  font-family: Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 24px;
}

.recap-grignan .conclusion p {
  color: #dce5ee;
  font-size: 16px;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

/* =====================================
   VIDÉO FACEBOOK (CADRE PAYSAGE + VIDÉO VERTICALE ENTIÈRE)
===================================== */

.facebook-video {
  max-width: 950px;
  margin: 25px auto;
  padding: 20px;
  background: transparent;
  border-radius: 14px;
  font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
  text-align: center;
}

.facebook-video h2 {
  color: #26394d;
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', sans-serif;
  font-size: 25px;
  margin: 0 0 8px;
}

.facebook-video .subtitle {
  color: #687585;
  font-size: 13px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.facebook-video .video-container {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  background: #000000;
  border-radius: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.facebook-video iframe {
  height: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 9 / 16;
  width: auto;
  max-width: 100%;
  border: 0;
  display: block;
}

.facebook-video .fullscreen-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin: 18px auto 10px;
  padding: 15px 24px;
  background: #1877f2;
  color: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 9px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .4px;
  text-decoration: none;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(24,119,242,.22);
  transition: background .2s, transform .2s;
}

.facebook-video .fullscreen-button:hover {
  background: #125fc4;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.facebook-video .button-icon {
  font-size: 22px;
  line-height: 1;
}

.facebook-video .facebook-link {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 8px;
  color: #3979ad;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: bold;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.facebook-video .facebook-link:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

/* =====================================
   RESPONSIVE
===================================== */

@media(max-width:620px) {

  .recap-grignan {
    padding: 18px 5px;
  }

  .recap-grignan .timeline {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .recap-grignan .card {
    padding: 17px;
  }

  .recap-grignan .header {
    padding: 25px 10px;
  }

  .recap-grignan .header-filigrane svg {
    width: 145px;
  }

  .recap-grignan .card-head {
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .recap-grignan h3 {
    font-size: 16px;
  }

  .recap-grignan p {
    font-size: 16px;
  }

  .facebook-video {
    padding: 13px;
  }

  .facebook-video h2 {
    font-size: 21px;
  }

  .facebook-video .video-container {
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
  }

  .facebook-video .fullscreen-button {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 14px 10px;
    font-size: 12px;
  }

  .lavande-filigrane {
    width: 110px;
    right: -12px;
    bottom: 5px;
    opacity: 0.12;
  }

  .ble-filigrane {
    width: 105px;
    left: -15px;
    bottom: 5px;
    opacity: 0.13;
  }
}

/* =====================================
   IMPRESSION
===================================== */

@media print {

  .lavande-filigrane,
  .ble-filigrane {
    display: none;
  }

}
</style>

     EN-TÊTE DE PAGE

<header class="header">

  <div class="header-filigrane" aria-hidden="true">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 260 66" xmlns="[http://www.w3.org/2000/svg](http://www.w3.org/2000/svg)">

<!-- =====================================
     LES SIX POINTS
===================================== -->

<div class="timeline">


  <!-- 01 : INAUGURATION -->

  <article class="card gold">

    <div class="card-head">
      <div class="symbol">🏛️</div>

      <div>
        <div class="number">01 · INAUGURATION</div>
        <h3>Une inauguration symbolique</h3>
      </div>
    </div>

    <p>
      Le <strong>19 septembre 2026</strong>, la municipalité inaugure
      l'installation en présence de Bruno Durieux, ancien maire et
      ministre, et de l'artiste Hélène Delprat.
      L'événement se déroule lors des Journées européennes du patrimoine,
      dont le thème officiel était
      <strong>« Patrimoine en péril »</strong>.
    </p>

    <div class="references">

      <a class="reference"
         href="https://www.coe.int/fr/web/portal/-/european-heritage-days-2026-heritage-at-risk-revive-resist-reimagine"
         target="_blank" rel="noopener">

        <span class="reference-icon">🇪🇺</span>

        <span>
          Conseil de l'Europe
          <small>Thème officiel des JEP 2026</small>
        </span>

      </a>

      <a class="reference"
         href="https://www.ledauphine.com/culture-loisirs/2026/09/20/au-four-banal-une-chambre-de-lecture-qui-invite-a-la-reverie"
         target="_blank" rel="noopener">

        <span class="reference-icon">📰</span>

        <span>
          Le Dauphiné Libéré
          <small>Article du 20 septembre 2026</small>
        </span>

      </a>

    </div>

  </article>


  <!-- 02 : PATRIMOINE -->

  <article class="card gold">

    <div class="card-head">
      <div class="symbol">🏚️</div>

      <div>
```
